channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Dan Craig | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Dan Craig from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Dan Bisaccio on Chris Quinn, Juwan Howard, Caron Butler, Malik Allen, Dan Craig
item.description:
Bisaccio, 34, spent last season as a Heat player development coach and has spent the past three weeks as the Heat’s summer league head coach.

“I’ve been a part of a variety of different coaches and different summer leagues — Dan Craig, Juwan Howard, Chris Quinn, Malik Allen and most recently Caron Butler,”

Dan Bisaccio on Chris Quinn, Juwan Howard, Caron Butler, Malik Allen, Dan Craig, Jul 22, 2024. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Dan Craig
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Ty Lue on assistant Dan Craig:

“Defensively, he's been great. And the way he speaks to the team, it's not *growling* growling tough, it's mild-mannered... usually defensive guys are always talking & loud. But he's mild mannered (to get) his point across.”

Tyronn Lue on Dan Craig, Feb 15, 2021. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Dan Craig
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Erik Spoelstra on life without Dan Craig:

“He was involved in everything ... he just helped me in all the facets of coaching. So it is, we're like brothers in this profession. It'll be weird seeing him tonight.”

Erik Spoelstra on Dan Craig, Jan 28, 2021. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.
